name: avatar
pattern: A headless avatar that synchronizes native image loading state with fallback display and announcements and root state output
responsibility: Determines loading / loaded / error for a native and synchronizes root data-state, image aria-hidden, and fallback hidden. It does not generate image URLs, alternative text, fallback content, or appearance

authorMarkup.root: Any HTMLElement with data-controller="avatar", containing an image target and a fallback target

targets.image: Exactly one non-focusable native with data-avatar-target="image". Always author an alt attribute. Keep src / srcset / sizes and the use of as native markup. When interaction is needed, make the semantic root or an ancestor a button / link rather than the image itself
targets.fallback: Exactly one HTMLElement with data-avatar-target="fallback". The user writes the text or element to display when the image has not loaded. The controller synchronizes hidden with the loading state

authorMarkup.source: Specify image URLs and responsive-image candidates with native attributes on image / picture. The controller does not duplicate them in data values. A configuration without an image source enters error state and can receive a source later
authorMarkup.alternativeText: The user writes image alt according to context. alt="" is valid for a decorative image. The user writes fallback text content or an accessible name so the same information is conveyed when the fallback is displayed
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate the image, fallback, alternative text, initials, or icon

semanticElements: The root must be an HTMLElement
The image target must be exactly one non-focusable native . tabIndex must be less than 0
The fallback target must be exactly one HTMLElement and must be a different element from the image target
The image target must have an alt attribute. An empty alt="" is valid
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate on connection, target changes, and alt changes on the current image target. When invalid, remove the image load / error listeners, do not update data-state, image aria-hidden, fallback hidden, or status, and call console.warn once while connected. Keep the attribute observer during connection to detect restoration of alt. Leave output synchronized before invalidation in place and resynchronize from the current image when valid again. Do not throw
contractValidation.warning: The disabling warning uses the standard form and includes the expected markup (an HTMLElement root, one non-focusable native image target with an alt attribute, and one HTMLElement fallback target). Enhancement has been disabled.
contractValidation.completionExempt: The controller does not supplement static attributes. data-state, image aria-hidden, and fallback hidden are controller-owned states synchronized with loading state and are not completion-warning targets

status.description: The last committed loading / loaded / error state. null until the first valid synchronization. Export AvatarStatus from src/index.ts

events.none: avatar does not dispatch custom events. The image target's native load / error events already report loading success and failure, so the controller does not duplicate them under another event name

consumerIntegration.css: User CSS reads root data-state=loading / loaded / error and decides dimensions, shape, color, transition, and how to display the image during loading / error. The controller does not change image hidden. Removing a loading=lazy image from layout with display:none or hidden during loading prevents the request from starting, so leave the image's layout box in place when loading should continue
consumerIntegration.nativeEvents: To receive loading results in JS, subscribe directly to the image target's native load / error events. They do not bubble, so write the Stimulus action on the image target as well
consumerIntegration.responsiveImages: Delegate candidate selection for srcset / sizes / picture to the browser. The controller does not parse URLs and uses only image complete / naturalWidth and native load / error as state sources
consumerIntegration.alternativeText: image aria-hidden and fallback hidden make image alt available when loaded and fallback content available during loading / error. The user is responsible for providing equivalent information when both represent the same person or account. For a decorative image, use alt="" and also remove the fallback from the accessibility tree
consumerIntegration.nested: Because avatar dispatches no custom events, events do not mix when avatars of the same type are nested

behavior.statuses: status has three values: loading / loaded / error. The root takes exactly one of them at a time
behavior.initial: After registering load / error listeners on the current image target, read complete and naturalWidth and synchronize the initial state without waiting for a cached event
behavior.loading: loading when complete=false. Check complete first even if naturalWidth retains a value from a previous image. Do not hide the image; leave its layout box available for native lazy loading
behavior.loaded: During initial synchronization and resynchronization after an attribute change, loaded when complete=true and naturalWidth>0. A trusted native load event commits loaded directly
behavior.error: During initial synchronization and resynchronization after an attribute change, error when complete=true and naturalWidth=0. A trusted native error event and a missing image source commit error directly
behavior.cached: For an image whose load / error completed before the controller connected, commit loaded / error from complete and naturalWidth without assuming that the event will be resent
behavior.nativeEventTrust: A synthetic load / error with isTrusted=false does not change state. Process only trusted events fired by the browser as a source-loading result
behavior.sourceMutation: While connected, observe src / srcset / sizes attributes on the current image target with a root-subtree MutationObserver and resynchronize loading / loaded / error from complete / naturalWidth after a change. Treat a trusted load / error received afterward as the final result. Treat property assignment reflected to the content attribute the same way
behavior.alternativeTextMutation: The root-subtree attribute observer also watches alt changes on the current image target. Removing alt disables enhancement; restoring the alt attribute resynchronizes from the current image. Keep the observer while invalid
behavior.responsiveReselection: Do not guarantee transient loading output for direct changes to picture source elements, image width / crossorigin / referrerpolicy, source insertion / removal / movement, or candidate reselection caused by viewport / DPR. Reflect the final load / error received by the current image target in state
behavior.eventAuthority: Because load / error are native events that report the loading result itself, the handler commits loaded / error directly without rechecking complete / naturalWidth. In a probe of the current three engines on 2026-09-03, complete=true / naturalWidth=0 held at error for network failure, 404, MIME mismatch, a broken image, and an empty image, with no engine difference observed
behavior.fallbackTiming: Do not delay fallback display. Set hidden=false when loading starts and do not have a delay value or timer
behavior.lazyLoading: In measurements on 2026-09-03 with Chromium 151.0.7922.34 / Firefox 153.0 / WebKit 26.5, hiding an offscreen loading=lazy image in the connection microtask prevented the request from starting and left complete=false. Removing hidden and moving it into the viewport caused it to load, so the controller does not change image hidden

managedMarkup.rootState: Synchronize root data-state with loading / loaded / error
managedMarkup.visibility: For loading and error, fallback.hidden=false; for loaded, fallback.hidden=true. fallback hidden is controller-owned, so synchronize a value authored earlier by the user with the current state. Do not change image hidden regardless of loading state
managedMarkup.aria: For loading and error, set image aria-hidden="true"; for loaded, remove aria-hidden to restore the native image's implicit accessibility. Do not use aria-hidden="false". image aria-hidden is controller-owned. Do not write role, aria-live, aria-busy, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or alt. The user decides the alt content and fallback accessible content
managedMarkup.preservation: Do not overwrite existing attributes other than root data-state, image aria-hidden, and fallback hidden, or image hidden, src, srcset, sizes, picture sources, alt, and text content

stateOutputs.ownership: root data-state, image aria-hidden, and fallback hidden are controller-owned. Root data-state is the only state output for CSS; do not duplicate data-state on image and fallback
stateOutputs.rationale: Emit it on the root because CSS cannot determine loading success, failure, or cached state and the component as a whole has one state
stateOutputs.targets: Do not emit target data-state because image / fallback loading state can be derived from the root. Synchronize only image aria-hidden and fallback hidden, which limit the accessibility tree to one side, and leave image visual visibility to user CSS

keyboard.none: avatar has no interaction and does not add keyboard events or focus movement

lifecycle: Revalidate changes from image / fallback TargetConnected / TargetDisconnected and alt changes on the current image target in the same microtask
Register a MutationObserver in connect() for src / srcset / sizes / alt attributes in the root subtree and remove it in disconnect(). Keep the observer while invalid to detect restoration of alt

Register load / error listeners on a valid image target and remove them from the old image when targets change, markup becomes invalid, or disconnect occurs. A delayed event from the old image does not change current state
Leave the last synchronized data-state, image aria-hidden, fallback hidden, and status in place on disconnect() and invalidation
On reconnection, synchronize from the current image target's complete / naturalWidth and do not register duplicate listeners or observers for the same instance
Track source changes only while connected and do not guarantee the intermediate state of a load that completed after the source changed while disconnected

observations.item: Loaded image and loading/error fallback announcements
observations.impact: State classification and the authored image/fallback semantics are fixed independently of announcement wording.

acceptanceCriteria: The AAA to achieve is 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception) (no feature is reachable only by pointer) and 3.2.5 Change on Request (the controller never moves focus and has no timer)
The behavior and accessibility covered by this component meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA
Incomplete, cached success, cached failure, and no image source are correctly classified as loading / loaded / error
status, root data-state, image aria-hidden, and fallback hidden agree for trusted load / error and connected src / srcset / sizes changes
Trusted load / error handlers commit the loaded / error indicated by the event and fallback display directly without rechecking complete / naturalWidth
For loading / error, image has aria-hidden=true and fallback is not hidden; for loaded, image has no aria-hidden and fallback is hidden. The controller does not change image hidden
Missing alt disables enhancement with one warning, and alt="" is valid
The only ARIA written by the controller is image state-synchronized aria-hidden; it does not write alt, image URLs, or fallback content and does not dispatch custom events
An offscreen loading=lazy image remains unhidden after controller connection and loads and transitions to loaded when moved into the viewport
Synthetic load / error does not change state
Dynamic removal of alt disables enhancement, and restoration resynchronizes the current image
Target changes and disconnect / reconnect do not duplicate listeners or observers, and events from old targets have no effect
Automated tests pass in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Report screen-reader announcements for the image when loaded and fallback when loading / error on a real device as unverified. Controller state classification does not depend on this result

testMatrix.description: Initial synchronization of incomplete images and no-source loading / error, the status getter, and root data-state
Classifying successfully completed and broken images from before controller connection as loaded / error using complete / naturalWidth without assuming completed events are resent

Direct commitment of loaded / error from trusted load / error and the path that does not re-evaluate an event result even when stale image properties are reproduced before the trusted event in Chromium

For loading / error, image aria-hidden=true and fallback hidden=false; for loaded, image has no aria-hidden and fallback hidden=true; image hidden is preserved and data-state is emitted only on the root
The controller does not hide an offscreen loading=lazy image, which transitions to loaded on a native load after it is moved into the viewport
The observer re-evaluates connected src / srcset / sizes changes and advances from loading to the final state from trusted load / error
The controller dispatches no custom events and synthetic load / error does not change state

One warning and disabling for an invalid root type, missing / multiple / wrong-type image or fallback targets, or missing image alt; permission for alt=""; and removal and restoration of alt after connection
Image / fallback target replacement, ignoring delayed events from the old image, and synchronizing current state to the new target
Listener and observer cleanup across disconnect / reconnect, retaining output, and synchronizing current state on reconnection

testMatrix: Engine-specific results for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Screen-reader results on a real device (unverified)
